Retention of high ductility of UFG TiNi is probably caused by the strain-induced martensitic transformation and the low modulus of elasticity of TiNi [1 1].

Correlation between the length of the plateau region on the curve /ESC–ε, connected with the strain-induced martensitic transformation, and the ductility during tension of the sample has been observed, which is indicative of the important role of martensitic transformations in the mechanical behavior of NC alloys.
